_meta.notes: Phase 3A survival model improvement (NB07). True baseline 0.514 (Cox PH, all-injury). Pre-tracking NB07 improvements (arm-only event, stratified Cox, elastic-net, GBSA addition) achieved 0.5559 best C-index as of 2026-06-19. Round S-001 established this as the formal starting point and added stochastic GBSA (subsample=0.8) achieving 0.5591 — delta +0.0032 < 0.005 → consecutive_non_improvements=1. Round S-002 tested GBSA column subsampling (max_features='sqrt') and n_estimators=200: both hurt C-index. Best config confirmed as max_features=None, n=100, subsample=0.8. consecutive_non_improvements=2. Full-run results pending.

round_S001.description: Stochastic GBSA via subsample=0.8 — Friedman (2002) stochastic gradient boosting
round_S001.verdict: kept — C-index +0.0032, GBSA now best model; delta < 0.005 threshold so consecutive_non_improvements incremented

round_S002.verdict: null result — column subsampling consistently hurts C-index on this dataset; max_features=None confirmed optimal; default reverted; consecutive_non_improvements=2. Full-run results pending.
